prompt:
A location picture for an illustrated text adventure on an early 1980s 8-bit home computer, drawn as vector line art with flat colour fills, the way an artist entered it point by point with a graphics tablet: clean, thin, uniform black outlines of constant width (about 4 pixels), every shape fully enclosed by its outline, mostly straight line segments and simple polygons instead of smooth curves, large simple shapes, very few small details. Each enclosed area is filled with one single flat colour: no gradients, no shading, no highlights, no texture, no hatching, no dithering, no noise, no brush strokes. Limited palette of about ten flat colours: deep blue and violet for the dusk sky, one orange band of light at the horizon, mid blue for the sea, white for the lighthouse, orange-red for its band and for the roof, warm brown for wood, grey for stone, green for grass on the headland, yellow for the lit window and the lamps. Black appears only as outlines, never as a fill. Strict frontal side view like a stage set, horizon at about 45 % of the image height; keep everything important between 12 % and 90 % of the image height, because the top and bottom edges will be cropped. The picture will be reduced to 280 x 160 pixels, so every object must be large and simple, nothing smaller than 1/50 of the image width. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a painting, not pixel art, not a postcard.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars. Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

The lighthouse lamp only as a small lit window at the top without any beam, no smoke from the chimney, no stars and no birds in the sky (all of these are animated separately).

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
